issues.text: The task says that at 390 px «the speaker stays beside the progress row». In the code the speaker is beside «‹ Назад» on the first row at 390 px and the progress is on the third row under the question title (the sample's phone layout); up to 379 px it is the other way: the speaker has its own row and «Назад» is beside the progress. I asserted what the CSS and decisions/0124 О36 say («390 px stays side by side»): at 390 px the speaker shares a row with «Назад» and does not reach over it; up to 379 px it does not share a row with it.

The edge is read at 379 px (own row) and 390 px (side by side); 380 px itself is not read, so a threshold moved to 380-389 px stays green. A row at 380 px would pin the other side of the edge; not asked for.

LD-8 now waits for #live to be non-empty before the switch to kk. setLang of the survey bumps `spoken`, so a pending announcement never writes after the switch, and without the wait the mutant E04 would stay green whenever the 30 ms timer had not fired yet. The wait is a condition with a 15 s deadline, no sleep.
